forbidden_inferences: a resolved spatial verb -> permission to append, retract, or infer identity or authority from a location
a subject having a coordinate -> that coordinate being disclosable; InformationPolicy still decides per field and per audience
an interpolated or simulated position -> an observation; the mode is carried precisely so the two cannot be read as one
two subjects sharing a coarse cell -> those subjects being near each other; a cell is a narrowing bucket and not a distance
a position being valid -> the subject still being there; valid_until bounds the claim and nothing renews it silently
a spatial relationship -> authority, permission, provider admission or an effect right on either subject
a derived position whose basis was retracted -> a position that still stands; it is reported as an orphaned derivation rather than quietly outliving the fixes that justified it
declared identifier equivalence -> two events being the same physical event; the record is that a source declared these identifiers together at an observed time, and a source can be wrong about that
an owner-transition receipt -> a correct interpretation, an admitted source, or an authorized downstream act; it says an owner accepted a handoff
being within a declared reach -> being visible; no elevation model is held here, so nothing occludes and a frustum answers what lies inside the declared cone rather than what could be seen
a spatial_candidate of bearing -> an observation, a reachable source, or an admitted one; it is what a description said about itself
a spatial_candidate of not_evident -> a source with no coordinates; a listing that said nothing about maps is a listing that said nothing
a durable copy -> a retention decision or an authority to delete the hot store
a receipted body -> a true one; a verified digest says these are the bytes that were observed, not that the source was right or that this estate may repeat what it said
an address -> access; the frontier travels and the population does not, so a shared link grants nothing that the recipient could not have asked for under their own closure
a reconstruction -> a recording; it is recomputed from append-only facts at a stated pair of frontiers and nothing replays a stored frame
internal_calculi: three times, not one: observed_at is when a source saw it, effective_at is when the position is claimed to hold, valid_until is when the claim expires rather than silently persisting as current

two independent time axes: valid time is effective_at..valid_until, when a position holds in the world; knowledge time is recorded_at, when this estate learned it. A reconstruction takes both, and defaults knowledge time to the valid instant so the default question is what was believed then rather than what is believed now about then

the bitemporal cut is: known by the knowledge frontier, not retracted by it, effective by the valid instant, and not expired at it. The expiry clause is kept separate from the others so that never having known and having known something that has since expired remain different answers

retraction appends rather than removes, so a reconstruction as of a knowledge time before the retraction still returns what was retracted; that is what makes an earlier answer reproducible rather than merely remembered

intake is a declared mapping, not a guess: which property carries the subject, which carries the source's own instant, and how that instant is shaped. A feature with no usable source instant is refused and counted rather than stamped with the moment of ingest, because a stamped feature is indistinguishable from a real observation forever afterwards

an ingest is idempotent by the whole source digest. Observing one document twice is one observation of one thing, and a shortened digest would make two documents share a coordinate and silently drop the second one's features

a frontier is addressable: /w/<world>/spatial?at=<instant>&as-of=<instant> carries the pair, plus extent, region, cell and an optional subject of interest. It carries projection coordinates only and never a population, so a recipient recompiles the closure under their own actor and policy and a link cannot hand anyone a subject, a position or a layer they could not have asked for themselves

the world closure runs both stages over one frontier: the plane names which subjects could participate from coarse coordinates alone, and the owner then reconstructs each survivor from its own complete log including facts that were never advertised

coarse addressing narrows and exact geometry answers: spatial/mobility/scale/region/cell/geometry_kind/mode reach the forwarding plane; intersects, within-radius, along-route, nearest-N and visible-from run on the survivors

the closure's cost was never where it looked. A quadratic insertion sort over the survivors made a whole-population query scale with the square of the population -- four times the subjects cost sixteen times the time while four times the bytes cost four -- and replacing it with qsort took twenty thousand subjects from 3.4 s to 0.145 s. Two planner hints were tried first and one of them made things worse; the lesson recorded here is that a set the query depends on is built into a temp table rather than declared as a CTE and hoped for

three indexes carry that: a partial index on retracts, because the retraction check is asked once per candidate row and otherwise falls onto the knowledge index, which at a late frontier matches nearly every fact ever written; an index on observation_id, which both the derivation check and the ingest idempotency guard look up by name; and a partial index over derivations, since only a derivation can be orphaned. The orphan set is built once into a temp table rather than expressed as a correlated check or a CTE, both of which measured slower than the rest of the query combined
invariants: the native Spatial verb is resolved before the store is opened; pure address rendering remains store-free and the six spatial query verbs retain their exact query mode through the shared command descriptor
a world reconstruction binds its exact read-only spatial index path as an ATTACH parameter; punctuation in a filename is not SQL text, a different source, or a writable plane
a feature without a geometry type is refused as invalid geometry before the owner compares or interprets that type
a coordinate is a statement about where an existing subject was observed or projected; it is never a new identity for that subject and a position arriving for an unknown subject creates nothing

observation_mode separates what a source stated from what this estate computed; observed and reported are claims by a source, and propagated, interpolated, inferred and simulated are derivations this estate owns

a display position computed between two fixes is not a third fix; derived positions name the observations they were computed from, so the two stay distinguishable after the fact and not only at the moment of writing
derived spatial state may move as fast as a surface needs; the observations underneath it are append-only and a 12 Hz projection writes no history
geometry, CRS and datum never become forwarding coordinates; a plane carrying geometry starts answering exact spatial questions cheaply and badly

the observation log is append-only and the store enforces it rather than trusting the writer; correcting a fact means appending a retraction, and both the fact and its retraction stay readable afterwards
a position expires rather than silently persisting as current; after valid_until there is no current position, and that is reported as expired and never as the last known place

an extent is never measured as a point; a polygon, line or multi-part shape stores no representative position, and distance is computed against the shape itself, because measuring to a centroid answers how far the middle is while reporting how far the thing is -- wrong by the size of it, and most wrong where it is largest

the maintained live view is derived state and never a second source of truth; a maintained read and a recomputed read must agree, and a disagreement is a defect here rather than a new fact about the world
a retraction is recomputed rather than patched forward; only an append moves the latest fact in one direction, and patching a retraction would leave the view asserting what the log no longer supports
the maintained view stores the latest known fact and never the assertion that it holds now; effectiveness and expiry are decided at read time against the instant actually asked about
a cold representation that cannot be thawed is a deletion with extra steps; the durable tier is verified by content and proved by restoring it
a bounding box exists only to narrow; it is a cheap rejection and never an answer, and no result reports a distance to one
a hole subtracts: a point in the courtyard of a building is not in the building
the occurrence coordinate is the receipt's own and never synthesized; a coordinate nobody else uses is not an identity, and facts carrying one report as depth zero while the chain is in fact running

a subject follows its identifier lineage rather than the latest label a source prefers; a source that changes its preferred identifier while still publishing the previous ones must not split one thing into two subjects
every owner handoff leaves occurrence-keyed evidence; a handoff that leaves none cannot be measured and is indistinguishable from one that never happened
intake produces source claims only; a derivation has to name the facts it came from and a source did not compute one

an estate cannot have learned a position before it was observed; a feature whose source instant is later than the moment of ingest is refused, because storing it produces a log that reconstructs to impossible pasts
a document that failed to parse is a failed observation and never an empty one, because an empty ingest looks exactly like a source that reported nothing
a surviving advertisement names a candidate subject and is never the set of facts about it; reconstructing only from advertised observations would let the forwarding plane decide what is true

parsing an address refuses rather than repairs: a missing frontier, a malformed instant and an undeclared coordinate are all errors, because a half-parsed address shows a reader an instant they did not ask for and does not say so
an exact spatial predicate runs at a reconstruction frontier, so each subject contributes at most the one position it held there; a subject with ten fixes is one thing in a place, not ten
known_gaps: distance is computed in a local tangent plane -- good to well under a metre at this estate's extents and not a geodesic, and it is not the answer to give for a continental span.
area-to-area overlap is answered as closest approach reaching zero rather than as a computed intersection geometry; nothing returns the shape of an overlap.
intake reads a receipt and does not ask for one. ForeignTwin still owns fetching, and nothing schedules re-observation, so a source is placed when someone runs it rather than when the source changes.

the 146 bearing occurrences are classified and not yet observed. Placing any of them still needs a ForeignTwin receipt per source, which is now the only step between the classification and a position.

identifier lineage resolves and never splits. If a source declares two identifiers together and later retracts that association, nothing un-merges the subject; the aliases are time-scoped and the merge is not.

the semantic rung stops at interpreted. No DomainProfile is bound for a seismic event, so nothing reaches profile_bound or carrier_conformant, and the braid cannot grow past this owner on the semantic axis.
temporal_candidate is still the literal "unknown" that spatial_candidate used to be. The same evidence would classify it and nothing has.
intake places GeoJSON points, lines, polygons and their multi-part forms. A GeometryCollection is refused and counted, and no non-GeoJSON encoding is read.

Zarr is deliberately not written. Zarr chunks N-dimensional arrays -- a gridded field sampled over space and time -- and an observation log is not that shape. This owner holds no raster and no continuous surface, so a Zarr tier here would be a container with nothing to put in it; a weather surface or an elevation model would want one, and that is a different record than this.
the durable tier is written and verified and nothing schedules it. Export, verify and thaw are invoked by hand, and no retention policy decides when a hot range becomes cold.

maintenance advances when it is run. Nothing triggers it on append, so a live read is refused until someone runs `maintain`; a Feldera/DBSP dataflow would remove the manual step rather than change the semantics, which are already measured against recomputation.

the served route shows the advertised population and nothing narrower. Publication is the disclosure decision it leans on; InformationPolicy is not consulted per field or per audience, so a World whose published subjects need audience-dependent disclosure is not yet served correctly.
